_units: native HUF model units, game axes (x lateral, y up, z back=+). Chin-to-sole H = 1.0761; h = (y + 0.697) / H.
_source: Reference silhouette comparison (reference_fit_20261005/curves_baseline.png, tabulate.py). Values are per side.

hip_narrowing._why: Front+back reference silhouettes: model hip/trochanter band h 0.56-0.68 is wider by ~1.1-1.7 %H per side. Pass 2: anterior hip-crease/inguinal surfaces (z < -0.025, front) protected after hip_rotation/high_kick/deep_flexion regression found new crossings there. Pass 3: top of band (h 0.66-0.70) reduced after high_kick crossings at the upper lateral hip. Pass 4: lateral silhouette extremes lie at z +0.003..+0.012, so all front-facing hip surfaces (z < -0.004) are protected (high_kick). Pass 5: h 0.66-0.70 reduced further (single high_kick pair at the upper lateral hip, LOD00/01). Pass 6: band ends at y 0.042 (h 0.686); a grazing high_kick contact at the upper lateral hip reacted to a 0.0006 move. Pass 7: extended down the outer thigh (h 0.30-0.54, ~0.6 %H per side) after per-view width fits showed thighs ~1 %H/side wide on 3 of 4 reference sides (front k 0.967, back k 0.926); front-left side already matched, so ~70 %% of the mean is applied. Pass 8: posterior thigh below the fold (z > 0.015, y < -0.11) protected after knee_bend/deep_flexion calf-contact reshuffles. Pass 9: posterior thigh protection tightened (z > 0.005) and band starts at h 0.34 (deep_flexion). Pass 10: thigh band starts at h 0.40; posterior protection begins just below the glute fold (LOD01 knee_bend/deep_flexion). Pass 11 (final): thigh band withdrawn (its posterior protection left a flat lateral strip with a V-shaped highlight edge for ~0.15 %H of fit); anterior transition widened (z +0.010 -> -0.060) to keep lateral hip curvature; posterior protection inactive (band ends above the fold).

waist_ribcage._why: Reference waist minimum 0.0756 H at h 0.74-0.75 (first loop above the locked seam ring) and lower-ribcage half-width ~0.084-0.087 H at h 0.78-0.80; model pinched at h 0.78 (0.0715 H). Pass 2 knots set from the candidate_v2 residuals. Pass 3: widening ramp at h 0.76-0.78 softened after a single torso_twist crossing. Pass 4: h 0.76-0.78 ramp softened again (torso_twist pair at lateral waist). Pass 5: ramp h 0.755-0.785 made more linear.

bust_lowering._why: Reference bust apex h 0.845-0.848 (front and profile) vs model nipple/apex h 0.860; reference IMF ~0.806 vs model ~0.812. Projection already matches. Areola + CB ring translate rigidly (no scale change). Two cubic ramps (below-IMF and lower pole) keep peak vertical compression near 20%; the SKIN_nipple patch (y 0.212-0.245) translates rigidly. Pass 2: below-IMF ramp limited to the front ribcage (z < -0.035) after a torso_twist crossing at the lateral waist.

glute_lower_fill._why: Back view: reference glute folds at h 0.546-0.56 vs model 0.585. Moderate posterior fill of the lower glute only; upper-glute/lumbar profile differences are attributed to reference pelvic tilt/staggered stance and not modelled.

forearm_thickening._why: Reference forearm silhouette (arms down, palms toward body) is ~10-15% wider at h 0.66-0.76 in front and back views. Thickening is applied to the dorsal/palmar (rest +/-y) extent only, away from elbow-flexion contact surfaces. Pass 2: rest +y side (inner-elbow contact in flexion) starts at |x| 0.33 after elbow_flex/forearm_twist crossings; -y side carries the near-elbow thickening. Pass 3: both sides start beyond |x| 0.335 (elbow_flex anterior contact); near-elbow forearm left at source width. Pass 4: start moved to |x| 0.35 (LOD01/02 elbow_flex).
